protocol: All points and SDF values retain radius-0.5 model units; no additional input scaling is applied.
Query scores use the dataset's balanced SDF samples; uniform scores are reported separately, with additive support counts. Sign ties within sign_eps are excluded.
Mesh validity means a finite nonempty nondegenerate level-zero surface, not guaranteed watertightness, correct topology, or raw-scan SDF reliability. Topology is reported separately.

Mesh CD compares area-sampled predicted triangles with stored reference surface points in the SAME representative coordinates. Invalid/missing surfaces receive null CD, never zero; valid-only averages are selection-biased.
Tiny demonstrations, untrained checkpoints, and GPU overfit examples are not paper-quality evidence or industrial/grasp-quality validation.

definitions.cd_n: Sum of both mean squared nearest-neighbor distances divided by oracle bbox diagonal squared; NO factor 0.5.
definitions.drift_valid_fraction: Fraction of valid pairs with CD_n > threshold; missing pairs excluded and separately counted.
definitions.failure_inclusive_fraction: Missing/invalid pairs plus drift failures divided by ALL requested pairs.
definitions.edge_distance: Mean distance from oracle vertices at/above the configured Laplacian percentile to sampled prediction, divided by oracle bbox diagonal.
definitions.sampling: Original Open3D uniform surface sampler, now explicitly seeded per pair. The original run did not seed Open3D's global stream; small differences are expected.
